name: claudecode
description: Configure Claude Code itself: flip the prompt-cache TTL between 5 minutes and 1 hour, and install the bundled status line.

interface.shortDescription: Prompt-cache TTL and status line for Claude Code
interface.longDescription: Two skills that configure Claude Code itself by patching settings.json. cache-ttl flips env.ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H so the prompt cache lives one hour instead of five minutes, and removes the key to go back. statusline-setup copies a bundled statusline-command.sh and statusline-tokens.sh into the Claude config directory and points the statusLine block at the installed path. Both target ${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude} so multi-account setups work, both merge with jq through a temp file so no unrelated key is ever lost, and both refuse to touch invalid JSON rather than guessing. Every file they need ships inside the plugin: no dotfiles checkout, no network.
defaultPrompt: Set my prompt cache TTL to 1 hour.
Install the status line for Claude Code.
